authority: Google Advertising Policies Help Center, English enforcement text

policy_families.notes: Standard image-ad policy plus animation duration requirements.
Blocks blurry/unclear/illegible, sideways/upside-down, distracting/strobing, non-full-space or encroaching image ads.

Includes fake system/site UI, non-functional controls, download/install buttons/icons in image ads, transparent backgrounds, segmented/multi-ad visuals, misleading arrows and disproportionate/contextless standalone buttons.
Covers misleading representation, unreliable claims, unclear relevance, unavailable offers and misleading design.
Inaccurate or improbable results presented as likely outcomes are not allowed.
Promotion must accurately describe and be relevant to destination content.
Advertised offer/price/CTA must be available and easy to find/use at the destination.
Destination working, accessible, crawlable, matched, useful and sufficiently original.
Trademark use may be restricted after complaint, especially direct-competitor or misleading use; reseller/informational use has contextual criteria.
Includes dangerous/derogatory, sexual, shocking and other prohibited content.
Healthcare, alcohol, gambling, financial services, politics and other restricted categories require live policy/geography/certification resolution.
Sensitive-interest personalization/targeting restrictions are campaign-level and separate from raster creative approval.

non_guarantee_statement: Local preflight cannot guarantee Google approval; Google review may consider ad, destination, account, targeting, geography and third-party information.
